explication: Humanizer-zh is an agent-executed editing skill, not a standalone detector or rewriting program. The main workflow is an agent applying SKILL.md to user-provided text or a file and returning a revised draft; the README also documents review-only use and optional author samples. The detailed editing rules and 31 checkpoints live in SKILL.md, but no source excerpts were provided, so the graph reflects only README-documented relationships.
